demonstration.narration: I'll open the records behind the ${var.value} requests/second bar to read how long those requests really took.
demonstration.reasoning: A chart bucket shows that latency is high, not where it starts rising. Reading the records on both sides of the change brackets the threshold.
demonstration.evidence: This record at ${var.value} requests/second took 1,200,000,000 ns, or 1.2 s (event.duration). Before we filtered, the panel showed 180 requests/second far lower, so the saturation point lies between them, around ${truth.finding}.
